AIRSIDE Kai Tak · Opening KOL Experience · October 2026

SEOUL, BY HAND

One goal: when Hong Kong thinks K-fashion, it thinks MLB.
Not a ribbon — a pastel mocktail bar at the storefront, a bedazzle wall running all afternoon, and twelve people who leave wearing a cap that did not exist that morning.

6 Oct 2026 — tentative 12 KOLs 1 mocktail bar — the SEOUL STAND, four pastel batches #bedazzled #MLBHK
IN-STORE INFLUENCER EVENT — AIRSIDE, KAI TAK
StoreMLB AIRSIDE (M24), Kai Tak, Hong Kong — 72.4 m² total, 58.1 m² sales floor
ConceptSEOUL, BY HAND — when Hong Kong thinks K-fashion, it thinks MLB. Told through Korea's trendiest culture — pastel, bedazzled, DIY — nothing on the day is watched; everything is made.
Event date6 October 2026 (Tuesday) — tentative
Objective
  1. Strengthen MLB's K-fashion standing in Hong Kong.
  2. Embrace the team-diversity concept — the league across the floor, not a single club.
  3. Open the door with something the concourse stops for.
Content
  1. 12 creators, each on site two hours.
  2. The SEOUL STAND — mocktail bar at the storefront: four pastel batches, transparent cups, the bedazzle sticker wall beside it.
  3. The gift: THE JELLY BAG — a transparent PVC tote with one MLB logo.
  4. Store tour video and asset usage.
Run of day
12:00 – 13:30
Set-up — bar, sticker wall, cupcake trays, mirror decal, stock the machine
14:00 – 16:00
Influencer window — arrive, mocktail, bedazzle the cup, cupcake, fit check, stitch
16:00 – 17:00
Store tour video, product capture, group frame at the stand
17:00
End — the bar strikes by 17:00 (mall rule); the mirror decal and the machine stay

Proposed. The creators' availability sets the final date. After the KOL window, the sticker wall and cupcakes open to walk-in customers while stock lasts.

01

Three experiences — not three photo ops

✨

Team-logo stickers and gems on her cup, a pastel logo sticker on her cheek — #bedazzled, cheek to cup.

Minutes at the machine and the cap belongs to one person only. They watch the needle put their own mark on it.

03

The store — the actual layout plan

The whole day happens in 58 m² of sales floor plus the storefront. Two of the five stops are fixtures the shop already has — the machine and the mirror; the bar and the bedazzle bar park at the storefront. The markers below are where each stop stands.

04

Five stations, drawn

Every stop is an object, not an adjective. Two of the five already stand in the shop — the machine and the mirror. What we add is the bar, its bedazzle bar, a caddy and a sheet of vinyl.

01 · THE SEOUL STAND

The approved barrow, repainted pastel: pitched sign board, six team marks, drop-leaf ledge and three high stools. The bedazzle bar parks on its right — full elevation in §04C.

02 · THE BEDAZZLE BAR

At the storefront — the stand's right wing. Sticker trays with the real team marks in pastel, gem pots, and the cupcake stand. Product-charm DIY stays parked in the drawer — the DIY lives in F&B.

03 · THE DRINK CADDY

A brushed stainless tray — twelve holes, cut handles both ends — on a slim stand at the door. Bedazzled cups park in it before anyone steps inside, stickers facing out. Nothing hot, nothing spillable — mocktails only.

04 · THE FIT CHECK

The existing W 1,250 mirror, dressed in applied vinyl: a scatter of team logos in pastel, top and bottom with the AIRSIDE plate at eye level. Shot high-angle so the cap leads the frame — a photobooth rig is the upgrade option (quote lands 16 Sep).

05 · THE STITCH

The machine we already own, on a bench with the thread stand beside it. The cap sits in the frame with the 40 × 35 mm side panel under the needle — worked standing, no stool.

WHAT WE ACTUALLY BUY

Two of the five are already standing in the shop.

The machine and the mirror are fixtures. We add the bar, the bedazzle bar, a caddy and a sheet of vinyl — and the day is built.

04B

The AIRSIDE mark

The graphic is what makes this store different. The flower stays; the lantern retires. Below: six pastel replacements — simple, Korean, one shape each, stitchable inside the 40 × 35 mm cap side panel. Choose one to partner the flower.

A

A · TWO FLOWERS KEPT

Two blooms, each carrying the other's colour.

B · TWO LANTERNS — RETIRED

The six pastel candidates below are the shortlist — same panel, same stitch rules, drawn to read at 40 mm.

C

C · THE BOW 리본

Ballet-core ribbon — the K-fashion motif of the season, and the softest thing a cap can carry.

D

D · THE BUBBLE 말풍선

A chat bubble holding a heart — Seoul says it in a sticker, so the cap does too.

E

E · THE SPARKLE 반짝

The bedazzle made stitchable — one big glint, two echoes. The event, drawn as a mark.

F

F · THE PHOTOCARD 포카

The collect ritual as a frame — a poca with a heart where the face goes: hers, at the mirror.

G

G · THE CLOUD 구름

A soft pastel cloud — reads cute at 40 mm, two threads, nothing to explain.

H

H · THE STAR CANDY 별사탕

Byeolsatang, the star candy — spiky, sweet and Korean since the school tuck shop.

The flower + one pastel pick, one rotation. Both go on the machine on the day — the creator picks which one goes on her cap.

04C

The F&B — the SEOUL STAND, now a mocktail bar

One barrow at the storefront. The approved café cart, repainted pastel: pitched sign board with six team marks, drop-leaf ledge, three high stools, one oversized wheel — mocktails on the counter, the bedazzle bar parked beside it. It strikes by 17:00.

Mocktail counter: four pastel batches in the counter jars — poured to order into transparent cups. The bedazzle bar beside it: six team sticker sheets, deco stickers, gem pots — she decorates her own cup on the spot. Cupcake stand on the counter, mini team caps. One server, install and strike by 17:00. Pastel mirror stickers and insurance in the same line. After the KOL window, the bedazzle bar and the cupcakes open to walk-in customers while stock lasts.

REFERENCE

The cupcake-in-a-cap post (IG story, @mlbkorea tag) — the look we are matching.

04D

The gift — THE JELLY BAG

Twelve bags. A transparent PVC jelly tote, one MLB logo, nothing else — the clear-bag trend carries the day home.

REFERENCE PHOTO

Retail clear-tote reference — welded PVC, printed face, contents as the styling.

One gift, one bag. She packs it herself at departures — the stitched cap, the mini cap tray, her bedazzled cup — and a bedazzle set of her own to keep. The frosted face shows all of it.
